title: CctpBridgeToolInput
description: Bridge USDC gaslessly across EVM chains using Circle CCTP. Amount is in human-readable USDC. Usually takes under a minute, and up to 5 minutes while waiting for the Circle attestation.

amountUsdc.description: Amount in USDC (e.g. 1.0 for 1 USDC). Maximum 100 USDC.

recipientAddress.description: Optional recipient address on destination chain. Defaults to the recipient smart account.
